title.zh: 以色列总理要求制定区块链方案，以应对以色列可能面临的经济制裁
title.en: 以色列总理要求制定区块链方案，以应对以色列可能面临的经济制裁

current_state.zh: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu said he has asked for a blockchain-based plan to help Israel withstand possible future economic sanctions, including banking restrictions, while warning that US military aid cannot continue indefinitely and announcing an additional 400 billion shekels (~$129B) in defense spending.
current_state.en: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu said he has asked for a blockchain-based plan to help Israel withstand possible future economic sanctions, including banking restrictions, while warning that US military aid cannot continue indefinitely and announcing an additional 400 billion shekels (~$129B) in defense spending.
